_comment: Tasks attempted by hand by a screen reader user. Automated testing catches roughly a third of WCAG failures, so this file carries the weight the scanner cannot. Replace the examples below with real observations, and delete any entry you have not actually run.

_schema.slug: must match a slug in scanner/targets.json
_schema.task: what the person set out to do, in plain words
_schema.completed: true or false, no partial credit
_schema.notes: what happened, in the tester's own words where possible

findings.task: Find the customer service phone number
findings.notes: Example entry. Delete this and record what your tester actually observed.
